post: <@1044008622067290174> St. Moses the Ethiopian, Moses the Black and the Strong, has been written into the next update with a full life drawn from the sayings of the Desert Fathers, including the pierced basket of sand he carried when the brethren called him to judge a fallen brother. Commemorated on the twenty-eighth of August. Thank you for the suggestion, and God bless you. Closing the thread.

<@797377338362167327> The Greatmartyr Niketas the Goth has been added for the next update, with a full life: a Goth of the lands beyond the Danube who confessed Christ under torture and was crowned by fire about the year 372, his relics later honored at Mopsuestia. Commemorated on the fifteenth of September. Thank you for the suggestion. Closing the thread.

<@1166399169188069529> St. Nino of Georgia, Equal-to-the-Apostles and Enlightener of Iberia, has been written into the next update, with the account of the conversion of the Georgian king and people and of her cross of grapevine bound with her own hair. Commemorated on the fourteenth of January. Thank you for the suggestion, and God bless you. Closing the thread.

<@890360261171638292> St. Xenia of St. Petersburg, the blessed fool for Christ, has been added for the next update, with a full life: the widow who gave away everything, took up her husband's name, and prayed through the nights for some forty-five years. Commemorated on the twenty-fourth of January. Thank you for the suggestion, and God bless you. Closing the thread.
